answer: The funding graph is partitioned each epoch and any partition holding more than 16 identities with no external edges is quarantined as a sybil cluster. Because the grove partition is computed from the dune history, the cipher audit publishes the cut and the operator cannot claim the cluster was accidental. Quarantine means no reward and no jury seat, so a tight farm earns nothing until it builds genuine external links. That is 33 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
